messages:
kelly: hi all, day 2! i'm poking at the local demo app and my streaming client gets 429s after a few seconds. should i be using my hosted org key for quick playback or is there a separate sandbox/dev key we should use for local streaming?

omar: welcome :wave: Use the sandbox/dev key for interactive dev. Hosted keys are reserved for staging/prod flows and have their own quota buckets + billing. Sandbox has tighter streaming limits to keep noisy dev clients in check.

kelly: ah ok. i can't find any sandbox key in Console -> API Keys, just the hosted one. did i miss a step when onboarding?

sylvia: if Sandbox is not showing up it could be due to exhausted trial credits or provisioning not finishing. Console -> API Keys -> Org dropdown -> look for a "Dev / Sandbox" tab. If it's missing, please file the provisioning request and ping #eng-infra.

kelly: the 429 I saw included this body: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","rate_bucket":"dev_stream_micro","retry_after":3}. is that helpful for infra?

infra-bot: yes — please paste the whole response when filing. rate_bucket like dev_stream_micro or sb_stream_small identifies the dev bucket. Quota request: https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/compute-quota. When requesting, say "new hire local streaming" and include sample request rate.

omar: extra tips: 1) shorten prompts while iterating, 2) don't auto-retry in tight loops, 3) honor Retry-After and implement exponential backoff, 4) if you need steady demo throughput request a temporary dev bump.

kelly: thanks! also, any recommended env var pattern so i don't accidentally commit keys?

sylvia: yes — add a .env in gitignore and use a .env.sample. example: export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sandbox_xxx" or REDWOOD_API_KEY="hosted_xxx". For demos use short-lived tokens.

onboarding-bot: Welcome, kelly! :tada: Helpful links: Getting started with dev keys — https://intranet.redwood/docs/dev-keys • Streaming best practices — https://intranet.redwood/docs/streaming-guide. Include full response JSON and rate_bucket when reporting 429s.

kelly: great, i'll check Console, file the quota form if needed, and paste the raw 429 here if it continues. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
